description.zh: 德鲁伊在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Druid talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【野性练级】先降技能消耗，再补移动速度、暴击，并在 25 级拿到 Primal Bite。全部点数投入野性战斗，60 级时就是一套完整的野性天赋。 【野性坦克】从野性战斗拿护甲、躲闪与耐力，靠血之狂暴和自然反射回怒，再点满激怒，每次变熊都带着怒气开场。
body.en: [Feral Leveling] Cheaper attacks first, then speed, crit, and Primal Bite at 25. Every point goes into Feral Combat, so the build is already a full Feral setup at 60. [Feral Tank] Armor, dodge, and Stamina from Feral Combat, rage from Blood Frenzy and Natural Reaction, and Furor so every shift into Bear Form starts with rage.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
